sealed_record.thesis: CoreWeave is a direct beneficiary of a structural compute shortage that new entrants (Meta, SpaceX) cannot resolve given current buildout plans. jukan05 models revenue of $12.7B/$27.3B/$41.8B for 2026-2028 with adjusted EBITDA of $7.5B/$15.6B/$21.2B and a $172 target (10x 2028 EV/EBITDA). The key differentiator is long-term take-or-pay contracts that give far greater revenue stability than on-demand or short-term rentals, insulating the neocloud model from the competition-and-demand-dispersion fear the market is pricing.
